text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whew... That felt great! Did ya see me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I think this is how I'm supposed to
be
runnin' these races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon we've done enough training to
take on
the big ones! Victory's gonna be
mine!

Taiki Shuttle performs amazingly well,
regardless
of the dirt track.

I've never doubted her abilities, but this
level of
growth is honestly shocking!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer! Does this mean we can
finally go to—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First, we celebrate our hard work with
some good
steak and carrot juice. ♪
